title: DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways=false is ignored from 1.20 — Certificates start re-keying

detection.reason: checked in the cert-manager workload's container args only — the gate set through a config file is not scanned

quote: The feature-gate `DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways` moved from Beta to GA and can no longer be disabled.
remediation: This controller opts out of the 1.18 rotation default, and 1.20 ignores the opt-out: every Certificate without an explicit `privateKey.rotationPolicy` gets a new private key at each renewal. Before upgrading, set `rotationPolicy: Never` on the Certificates that must keep their key, then remove the gate.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata as $m | .spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]? | select(test("(?i)DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways=false")) | "\($m.namespace)/\($m.name) \(.)"'  # each row is a controller relying on the opt-out 1.20 removes; NO rows = clean
